Guest visit

Volunteer program

Volunteers are vetted with care — experience matters, and so does heart. Tell us honestly what you bring.

Living on the land

Residency grows out of time spent here first — most residents start as guests, volunteers or stewards.

Land Steward application

Stewards earn the same standing as a 1% Partner through sweat equity: 2,222 hours over 5 years (about 444–445 hours a year, and it can be finished in as little as 2 years). Only 12 steward places exist, stewards meet with the Foundation weekly, and vetting is rigorous — proven experience matters more than need.

Partner interest

Partners fund the payoff of the 372 acres and the first building phases. A partner becomes guardian of a themed area, chooses a permanent campsite, and may develop and improve it — keeping it maintained to keep Resident Partner standing.

Which partnership are you considering?

Corporate land-trust partnership

Annual supporters of the Lake Waldensia Land Trust receive limited rights to create a permanent campsite for company retreats — a hands-on, tax-deductible way to give employees and their families time on protected land.

5

Agreements

The land asks a few things of everyone who comes to it.

For partners, co-founders and land stewards: this registration is an expression of interest, not a purchase. It is not a purchase of land, not equity or ownership in the Foundation or the Land Trust, and it promises no financial return. Partnership and steward standing are subject to interview, vetting and board approval, and final terms are set in written agreements reviewed by counsel.

Review & send

This is exactly what will be sent to will@tglff.org. Check it over, then tap the send button — your registration goes straight to the Foundation’s inbox from this page, and you’ll see a confirmation here.

Fill in the form and your registration summary will appear here.

No account and no password needed. If the direct send can’t get through (no signal in the hollow, for instance), the form automatically opens your email app with the same registration filled in and addressed to will@tglff.org — or use Copy / Download above and send it yourself.
